tasks.title: Симулятор: поднимаем дата-центр oVirt
tasks.statement: Соберите окружение oVirt так, как это делает администратор в Administration Portal: кластер, хосты, логическая сеть vm-net, домен хранилища и виртуальная машина. У каждого объекта свои состояния, и порядок действий важен: домен создаёт хост со статусом Up, дата-центр оживает только после активации главного домена, а сеть, обязательная для кластера, переводит хосты без неё в NonOperational. Упражнение решено, когда выполнены все три цели.
tasks.hint: Начните с кластера и хоста. Сеть vm-net делает хосты без неё NonOperational — назначьте её на сетевые карты. Домен проходит три шага: создать, подключить, активировать. Чтобы хост ушёл в обслуживание, виртуальной машине нужен другой хост с её сетью.

goals.text: Bring the data center to Up: a host and the master storage domain are active
Run a VM whose NIC is on the vm-net network
Put the host running the VM into maintenance so that the VM migrates to another host

tasks.title: Доска: собираем окружение oVirt
tasks.statement: На доске вы собираете окружение oVirt: добавляете движок, дата-центры, кластеры, хосты, логические сети, домены хранилища и виртуальные машины и соединяете их. Статусы выводятся из связей: хост без обязательной сети — NonOperational, без сети управления до движка — NonResponsive, дата-центр без активного главного домена — не Up. Кнопки «Путь сообщения» показывают, как команда движка идёт по сетям и где обрывается. В пяти сценариях соберите или почините окружение. Упражнение решено, когда цели всех сценариев выполнены.
tasks.hint: Связь тянется от выхода одного объекта ко входу другого: движок → дата-центр → кластер → хост. Сеть определяют в дата-центре, подключают к кластеру и назначают на хост, а у движка должна быть карта в сети управления. Домен подключают к дата-центру и затем соединяют с каждым хостом. Нажмите на объект: справа будет причина его статуса.

scenarios.title: Assemble the hierarchy
scenarios.story: An empty board. The engine has to manage a data center with a cluster of two hosts. Hosts are managed over a network: without it the engine cannot reach VDSM.
scenarios.goal: Two hosts are Up and the engine reaches both of them
scenarios.hint: engine → data center → cluster → hosts. The network is defined in the data center, attached to the cluster, assigned to every host and given a NIC on the engine; its role is “management”.

scenarios.title: Bring the data center Up
scenarios.story: The hosts are Up, but the data center is not: it has no storage. Add an NFS domain. Beware: once a domain is attached to the data center, every host of it has to see the domain.
scenarios.goal: The data center is Up, has an SPM, and both hosts stay Up
scenarios.hint: Attach the domain to the data center, then connect it to both hosts. The first attached domain becomes the master.

scenarios.title: A second data center
scenarios.story: One engine can manage several data centers, but networks and storage domains never cross their borders. Add a second data center with its own cluster, host, network and domain.
scenarios.goal: Two data centers are Up, each with an Up host
scenarios.hint: A network and a storage domain belong to one data center only: the second one needs its own, with the same roles.

scenarios.title: Why are the hosts not Up?
scenarios.story: The environment was built by hand and two hosts do not work: one reports NonOperational, the other NonResponsive. A VM sits on the first of them. Select a host to read the reasons.
scenarios.goal: Everything works and the VM can be migrated
scenarios.hint: NonResponsive: the engine has no management network to the host. NonOperational: a required network is not assigned to the host.

scenarios.title: A VM stays in its cluster
scenarios.story: A VM runs on the only host of cluster-a. The second host sits in another cluster, so the VM has nowhere to go: live migration is possible only inside a cluster.
scenarios.goal: The VM can be live-migrated, and everything keeps working
scenarios.hint: Add a host to the cluster of the VM. It needs the same networks and the same storage as the others.

tasks.title: Доска: кластеры и размещение
tasks.statement: Собирайте среду oVirt на доске: кластеры, хосты, сети и машины. Пять сценариев: расставить машины по хостам так, чтобы каждую можно было мигрировать; подключить сеть ко всем трём кластерам; перенести хост из одного кластера в другой; вернуть в дата-центр кластер, который в него не входит; перенести кластер в другой дата-центр. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Кластер — граница живой миграции, дата-центр — граница сетей и хранилищ. Выберите объект, чтобы прочитать причину его статуса.

scenarios.title: Place the VMs
scenarios.story: Three VMs were created and their disks and NICs are in place, but none of them runs: they are not placed on any host. The hosts, networks and storage are fine.
scenarios.goal: Every VM runs and every VM can be live-migrated
scenarios.hint: A VM runs on one host, and live migration needs a second Up host in the same cluster. Count the hosts of each cluster before you choose.

scenarios.title: A network in every cluster
scenarios.story: web-2 and web-3 are Down although their hosts are Up. Select a VM to read why: the VM network was set up for cluster-a only.
scenarios.goal: All three VMs run and vm-net is attached to every cluster
scenarios.hint: A network reaches a host only through its cluster: attach it to the cluster first, then assign it to the hosts. A required network has to be on every host of the cluster.

scenarios.title: Move a host to another cluster
scenarios.story: db-1 is the only VM of cluster-b and runs on its only host, so it cannot be live-migrated, while cluster-a keeps three hosts for a single VM. db-1 has to stay in cluster-b, where db-net lives.
scenarios.goal: Every VM can be live-migrated and all four hosts work
scenarios.hint: A host belongs to one cluster: remove the link and make a new one. Leaving a cluster drops the networks and storage of the host, and the new cluster has required networks of its own.

scenarios.title: A cluster outside the data center
scenarios.story: host-3 and host-4 were added to cluster-b, but both show the status No cluster. Select a host to read the reason.
scenarios.goal: All four hosts are Up and the engine reaches each of them
scenarios.hint: A cluster has to be in a data center before a network can be attached to it. Then the new hosts need the same networks and the same storage as the old ones.

scenarios.title: Move a cluster to another data center
scenarios.story: Remote has a single host, so the whole data center would stop if that host failed. Default has more hosts than it needs.
scenarios.goal: Both data centers stay Up when any single host fails, and all four hosts work
scenarios.hint: A cluster belongs to one data center. Moving it drops its networks and storage, because those belong to the old data center; the new one has its own.

tasks.title: Доска: головоломки иерархии
tasks.statement: Пять головоломок на одной доске: среда без менеджера, сеть не в том дата-центре, машина с чужим диском, три дата-центра с оборванным путём менеджера и среда с тремя независимыми неисправностями. Читайте причины статусов и проверяйте путь команды. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Идите от симптома к причине: статус объекта, его причина, звено иерархии, которого не хватает.

scenarios.title: Nobody manages this environment
scenarios.story: An existing environment was imported onto the board, but every host is NonResponsive and both data centers are down. Select a host to read the reason.
scenarios.goal: Both data centers are Up and the engine reaches every host
scenarios.hint: Hosts are managed through the engine: it has to manage each data center and needs a NIC in the management network of each one.

scenarios.title: A network in the wrong data center
scenarios.story: web-2 runs in the Remote data center but is Down: its virtual NIC is plugged into vm-net, which is not on host-2, and the board will not let you add it.
scenarios.goal: Both VMs run, each with a virtual NIC
scenarios.hint: A logical network belongs to exactly one data center. Define a network in the data center of the host, attach and assign it, and plug the VM into it instead.

scenarios.title: A VM with no host and a foreign disk
scenarios.story: web-1 is not placed on a host. Its NIC is in a network of the Default data center, but its disk is on a storage domain of the Remote data center.
scenarios.goal: web-1 runs and can be started, with a disk and a NIC
scenarios.hint: A VM runs on a host of one data center and can use only the networks and domains of that data center. Choose the data center that has the network, then give the VM a disk there.

scenarios.title: Two data centers out of reach
scenarios.story: The engine manages three data centers, but the hosts of two of them are NonResponsive. There is no storage yet; for now only the reach of the engine matters.
scenarios.goal: All five hosts are Up and the engine reaches every one of them
scenarios.hint: A command goes from the engine through a NIC and a management network to the host. Run the check and read which hop breaks for each host.

scenarios.title: Three faults in one environment
scenarios.story: The environment is not healthy: some hosts are NonOperational and a VM does not run. The faults are in different layers. Select the objects to read the reasons.
scenarios.goal: Everything works and every VM can be started
scenarios.hint: Each reason points at a different layer: networks, storage, placement. Fix them one at a time and watch the statuses change.
